notes.title: Release Notice
notes.notes:
Dear players, Infinite Tao has been fully released, Thanks for your support. I will continue to update.

Elixir
- Remove Wind Elixir
- New Green Dragon Elixir, White Tiger Elixir, Vermilion Bird Elixir, Black Tortoise Elixir (Effect: Can't reroll certain synergie Magic Treasures and Get Spiritual Energy)

Character
- XiaoXiao Su: Tian Synergy +1, +70% ATK for every 50 Levels, 

Synergie
- Bow: (6)  +50% ATK for each additional Magic Treasure of the same name with the same star → (5) +40% ATK for each additional Magic Treasure of the same name with the same star
- Tian: (2) Get Spiritual Energy +15%, (4) Get Spiritual Energy +20%, (6) Get Spiritual Energy +40% → (3) Get Spiritual Energy +30%, (6) Get Spiritual Energy +50%,

Other
- Overflowing Crit Chance will be converted to Crit damage
- The highest record of using the Destiny Talisman will be displayed after using seven Destiny Talismans to pass Void Junction.
